'''Khourlet''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Republic Strategic High Command]] and [[War Trust]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He and his men engaged a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], [[Darth Baras]]' [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]], and were all killed.
